text: The door to the March, the world the tribes left behind. It needs no Pulse: **beat out its rhythm** and the rhythm itself opens the way.

pages.title: Crossing over
text: Right-click the drum with an **empty hand** to begin the **Gate Rite**. A drumming song of 20 to 30 seconds plays, and its beats fall toward a line on four drums in a row: **A** is the deep frame drum, **S** the low tom, **D** the high hand drum and **F** the rattle.
Strike each drum as its beat reaches the line, with the music. The rattle counts you in, and the rhythm builds as the song goes.

The four drums answer **A**, **S**, **D** and **F**, and the arrow keys always work too. You can bind each drum to another key under Tribal Power in Options, Controls; A, S, D and F still drum as well.

pages.title: Landing the rite
text: Land **60%** of the beats and the gate opens, carrying you through. Pressing when no beat is there counts against you, so keep to the rhythm rather than drumming at random. Fail, or stop with **Esc**, and just strike the drum to try again.
The world does not stop while you drum, so clear the area first. A redstone signal locks the drum, and you cannot cross while riding.
You arrive on the surface of the March at the same spot on the map. Your first visit attunes you to the Deep Cache, so opening one is free from then on.

steps.caption: Place the Gate Drum somewhere with room around it.
Right-click it empty-handed and beat out the rhythm on A, S, D and F to walk into the March.

pages.title: Coming home
text: In the March, beat the rite on **any** Gate Drum to go home, so pack a second drum to set down there.
It takes you back to where you left, onto the nearest safe spot beside it, clear of campfires, slabs and wiring. If that spot is gone, it takes you to your spawn point.
Your return point is kept even if you die in the March.
An Astral Compass bound at home works too. A Waystone or Horizon Compass stays within one world, so it cannot bring you back.

pages.title: Before you go
text: Take food, armour and full Pulse Cells.

The March has fifty-nine lands in six bands; the first you are likely to meet are the Steppe, the Highlands, the Crystal Fields, the Snow Fields, the Ember Wastes, the Reed Fen, the Glimmer Ridge and the Shallows. Read every tablet in an [Ancestor Hall](ancestor_hall), and look for [Drum Circles](drum_circle) in the Highlands.
See [The March](the_march) for what lives there.
